talentName: Sage Jutsu Shadow Clone / Sage Jutsu Chakra
talentDesc: Summons the clone at battle start and grants 20 Chakra before the first action of each round. Talents have no cooldown.

talentName: Senjutsu Power / Tale of Jiraiya the Gallant
talentDesc: Prompt. Chakra 20; cooldown 3 rounds; battlefield cooldown 0. Consumes the primary action. Toad Esophagus for 2 rounds: barrier creators/destroyers on both sides cannot cast Mystery. Immediately casts Toad Confrontation Chant. Damage up to 2 enemies. Suppress Immunity and apply Extreme Chaos for the hit round only. Targets are protected against another Toad Chant control through the next round. Cooldown 2 rounds. Uses the primary action; waits while recovering. Unavoidable lineup damage, 5 COMBO. Stackable -10% Resistance. High chance (local: 70%) of Knockdown to selected target. Cooldown 2 rounds; cannot be bypassed by Chase bonuses. At least 15 COMBO. Damage up to 4 enemies, Repulse to selected target. +1 Chase limit for allies without Chase cooldowns this round, non-stacking. Round start: restore chakra limit to 100; +2% team Initiative each round, up to 10%. Cleanse Jiraiya and up to 2 other Senjutsu allies; +20 shared chakra for each. After defeat, revive at 30% HP after allies cast 3 Mysteries. Preserves cooldowns and cannot act again in the revival round.

Two Standards every round. Once per battle below 50% HP: enter Rage and recover 50% max HP. Rage grants enhanced Mystery, Standards and Chases, 12% Life Steal, enhanced Kamui at the beginning of every round (no cooldown) and one additional Standard after defeating an enemy with a Standard. Triggered at 20 Combo: damage up to 7 enemies and absorb 20 shared chakra per hit enemy. Once per round. No cooldown. Per-round Chase limits still apply. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. Chase Low Float: consumes 5% max HP, damages all enemies in the same line, causes Knockdown, Immobile for 1 round and Level 2 Kamui Tag. Ignores a portion of Defense and Resistance. Once per round. No cooldown. Per-round Chase limits still apply. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. Rage 20 Combo Chase: damage up to 7 enemies; Suppress Immunity for 1 round; absorb 20 chakra per hit enemy. Once per round. No cooldown. Per-round Chase limits still apply. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. Rage Chase Low Float: no HP cost; damage all enemies in the same line, Knockdown, Immobile for 1 round and Level 2 Kamui Tag. Ignores a portion of Defense and Resistance. Twice per round. No cooldown. Per-round Chase limits still apply. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. Rage Mystery. Damage all enemies, Low Float to selected target; +40% Chase damage until round end (does not stack). Chakra 40, reduced by 20 after each use to minimum 0. Cooldown 3 rounds, battlefield cooldown 0. Prompt; does not consume a Standard. Local automatic combat casts at most once per round. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.

talentName: Outer Path / The One called God / Shurado - Laser Canon
talentDesc: Prompt. Consume 1 Technique Point and 20 Chakra. Damage and Interruption to up to 7 enemies. Selected target: Horror II and Mystery Chakra Cost +20 (stackable) through round end. Cooldown 2 rounds; battlefield cooldown 0. Below 60% HP becomes Extreme - Almighty Push. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. Consume all Technique Points and 20 Chakra. Damage, 5 Combo and Interruption to all enemies; selected target: Repulse, Horror II, Mystery Chakra Cost +20 (stackable) through round end. Cooldown 3 rounds; battlefield cooldown 0. 7% Life Steal. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. Final Mystery. Consume 2 Technique Points, Chakra 0, cooldown 2 rounds (up to two casts in an eligible round), battlefield cooldown 0. Unavoidable damage, 5 Combo and Interruption to all enemies; selected target: Repulse, Horror II and Mystery Chakra Cost +20 (stackable) through round end. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. Attack up to 6 enemies, causes 4 Combo, reduces own Mystery cooldown by 1 and gains 1 Technique Point. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. No cooldown. Chase Repulse or Knockdown. Causes Knockdown, Chakra Disruption II and Pain II; target Chakra Limit becomes 20 through round end. Causes 30% splash damage to units 1 grid away. Never misses; ignores part of Defense/Resistance. Chakra Disruption II: Attack/Ninjutsu -10% per opposing Rinnegan ninja through next round end. Pain II: Defense/Resistance suppressed to 75% of base stats; lose 10% current HP on every Standard through next round end. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. No cooldown. At the beginning of every round, unleash a massive laser across ALL enemies in every row and remove 10 Chakra per hit unit. Gain 1 Technique Point; immune to Interruption for the round. Allied Rinnegan ninjas have unavoidable Mysteries through round end. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. Outer Path - Six Paths of Pain: up to 5 Technique Points, each increases Attack and Ninjutsu by 12%. Gain 0.5 point whenever attacked. First defeat per battle: revive with 100% HP, lose ALL current skills, gain ONLY Final - Almighty Push and Final - The One called God. Final - The One called God: Super Armor and immune to Debuffs; up to 2 Mysteries per round. Up to 5 Technique Points; Attack and Ninjutsu +20% per point. Gain 1 point whenever attacked. Critical Hits increase hit target Mystery Chakra Cost by 20. Once per battle, if another allied ninja is defeated, revive at 40% HP and trigger Super - Almighty Push. Triggered after Final revival. Unavoidable damage, 5 Combo and Interruption to all enemies. All enemies Mystery Chakra Cost +20 (stackable) through round end. Does not consume Technique Points or Chakra. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF. The One called God: every damage event scales Attack by 12%; Critical Hits inflict Chakra Disruption II. Cancel incoming Debuffs except Level 2; each cancellation increases Initiative by 2%, stacking up to 5. Horror II (Fear): cannot Standard Attack or receive external Buffs, stat increases or Shields until next round end or the affected unit executes a Mystery.

talentName: Chakra Burst / Senjutsu Power / Advent of a World of Flowering Trees
talentDesc: Chakra Burst: first damage each round grants Excited Mode (Attack/Ninjutsu +60%, Defense/Resistance -30%) through round end. Each damage event grants 0.5 Technique Point (max 2); Defense +20% per point. At 2 points consume all, recover 40 Chakra, enter Burst. Base Senjutsu: immune to Debuffs, heal 25% max HP and Mystery cooldown -1 whenever damaged. Burst: advanced immunity, Fire immunity, +30% damage, defense penetration on Chases; living Burst Hashirama grants allies +3% Attack/Ninjutsu stacks whenever they deal respective damage. Each activation and deactivation of Burst adds permanent stacking +10% Mystery damage. End of round: leave Burst, activate Deep Forest and Explosive Mode for 2 rounds. Under the forest, Explosive units using Mysteries inflict Root Binding II on hit targets for the round (cannot Standard, Defense/Resistance fixed to 100% base). Deity Gate Seal II: cannot Mystery, guaranteed Critical Hits locked to 1.5x for the round. Weakness II: Attack/Ninjutsu fixed to 75% base through stated duration. Any formation position. Mysteries: 3/2 round recovery, Chakra 20/40; Chase twice per round; additional skill once per round. Deals physical damage, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.

talentName: Orochimaru's Advance Technology / Mecha-Naruto - Jet / Tailed Beast Mode
talentDesc: Immune to Debuffs. Each executed action grants +8% Critical Rate and +15% Physical ATK, up to 6 triggers per round; growth persists through battle. Jet has a high chance to evade one ordinary attack per round and a 45% chance to evade Chases. On evade, recover 20 Chakra and trigger Extreme Beam, up to 3 times per round, even while controlled. Any formation position. Unspecified high chances are configured as 60%. After Chakra Bomb, permanently replace all base skills with Tailed Beast Mode: Energy Recovery (Mystery), additional Chakra Bomb, even-round Claw Strike and odd-round Tail Sweep; no base Standards, Rasengan, Jet or Technology triggers remain. Super Armor and Debuff immunity. Each Kurama Trigger grants +20% Physical ATK, stacking. Attacks received reduce Mystery recovery by 1. Energy Recovery activates permanent Explosive Mode: damaging enemies gain up to four Inflammation stacks; each physical action costs them 1% max HP per stack. All attack damage is physical, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.

talentName: Sho - Gyoku / Rei - Byaku / San - Hoku / Akatsuki Leader / Crow Clone Jutsu
talentDesc: The first two Mystery, Trigger and Standard Attack damage instances received each round are reduced by 50%, triggering Deidara/Sasori, Pain/Konan or Hidan/Kakuzu respectively. Clears Ignition when attacked by Mystery, Fear/Discouragement when attacked by Trigger. Cancels incoming debuffs including Level 2 and grants Hiding. Critical damage grants +8% Critical Rate and heals 15% max HP, up to five times per round. While alive, attacks damaging allied Akatsuki suppress attacker immunity (Ninjutsu) or Super Armor (Taijutsu). Evading grants +12% Physical ATK up to seven times per round. Crow Clone Jutsu activates after an allied Akatsuki first action each round, greatly increasing chase evasion; chase damage grants +20% DEF/Resistance up to 100% for the round. SSS; any formation position. All attack damage is physical, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.

talentName: The Two Great Visual Jutsu / Susanoo - Dominance
talentDesc: Melee swordsman. Super Armor and debuff immunity. Two Mysteries per round; first two Mystery attacks received are reduced by 40%, first two pure Taijutsu attacks deal no damage. While alive, grants team +18% attack scaling and +7% critical rate when executing skills. Amaterasu Blaze: attacks shred own ATK/Ninjutsu 1%; damage received shreds own DEF/Resistance 2%, through next round. Electrocution suppresses 75% of Resistance this round. Disorder: first critical hit each round reduces attacker critical rate by 15% and stores 10% max-HP damage for round end. Extreme Fear blocks standards and buffs and deals 5% current HP per action (cap 3000) at round end. Static applies Level 2 Paralysis on Trigger actions, or teamwide on Mystery. All damaging actions hit all targets and use Physical ATK/DEF. All attack damage is physical, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.

talentName: Frog Squad Cooperation / Frog Squad Lead
talentDesc: Frog Squad Cooperation: whenever a Frog Squad ally executes a Chase, that ally gains 8% Physical ATK (stackable). Remains active after Nagato is defeated. Frog Squad Lead: before his first action each round, reduces his Mystery cooldown by 1 and sets his Mystery Chakra cost to 0 until the end of the round. All attack damage is physical, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.

talentName: Gaara of the Sand / Summer Spirit - Raging Sand
talentDesc: Gaara has Super Armor. Sandstorm is followed by Sand Surfing. Whenever Gaara causes a Critical Hit, inflicts Level 2 Blindness for 1 round, preventing Standard Attacks. Level 2 Super Armor blocks Low Float, High Float, Repulse, Knockdown and lower-level Suppress Super Armor. At the beginning of every round, deals unavoidable small physical damage and Level 2 Discouragement to up to 4 front enemies. Discouragement prevents receiving external Buffs, stat increases and Shields until the end of the next round or executing a Mystery. Additional Skill after Sandstorm: unavoidable physical damage to up to 6 enemies. Suppresses Super Armor until round end and reduces each target Critical Rate by 15% (stackable). While Gaara is alive, whenever a non-Swimsuit/non-Summer unit on either team takes its first damage in a round, that unit Standard Attack damage is reduced by 50% and healing received by 40% until round end. All attack damage is physical, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.

talentName: Reserve Seal / The Legendary Sannin / Giant Katsuyu
talentDesc: Reserve Seal: immune to Debuffs. Physical damage to Tsunade has a 45% chance (75% after revival) to cause Chaos and Weakness for 1 round. First defeat revives at 100% max HP, once per battle. Legendary Sannin: Konoha-tagged allies receiving extra Standards grant Tsunade an extra Standard, at most 3 per round. While alive, the first Mystery damage received by each other Konoha-tagged ally each round cannot defeat them. Giant Katsuyu heals up to 9 allies for 25% Physical DEF and cleanses all Debuffs at the end of rounds 1, 2 and 3; after revival, becomes a selectable allied-target Mystery instead. After revival, before each Mystery summon 3 Small Katsuyu, each with 15% of Tsunade max HP; their Standard or fatal damage heals a random ally and restores the team Chakra Limit to 100. All attack damage is physical, scales with Physical ATK and is mitigated by Physical DEF.

talentName: Tailed Beast Coat / Tailed Beast Chakra - Wars
talentDesc: Tailed Beast Coat: When causing Taijutsu damage against Naruto, the attacker will suffer Ignition. Tailed Beast Chakra - Wars: Before each round's action, recover Life based on own Physical ATK attributes. Immune to all Debuffs. Ignition: Units affected cannot receive Healings and suffer damage at the end of the round. Lasts for 1 round.

talentName: White Zetsu Mutation / Wood Style Chakra
talentDesc:
Tobi has Wood Style Chakra. Whenever Tobi defeats a unit with Kanzeon Lotus King - All is Suffering, scales his Attack and Ninjutsu by 40% and after Tobi executes it, summons 2 White Zetsus with 60% of his max HP and has Spore Jutsu.

Tobi is immune to Debuffs. Whenever Tobi executes a Trigger skill, recovers 20 Chakra. Whenever Tobi suffers fatal damage, if there is a White Zetsu in your lineup, sacrifice the Clone with the lowest HP to revive Tobi to 40% HP.

White Zetsu cannot be defeated by Mystery skills and recovers 50% HP at the end of the round. While White Zetsu is alive, whenever a ninja in your lineup is attacked for the first time in a round, all units in your lineup will have their Mystery's Chakra Cost decreased by 10 and if that damage is a Mystery's damage, decreases 20 instead (stackable up to 40), lasts until the end of the round.

White Zetsu cannot be defeated by Mystery skills and recovers 50% HP at the end of the round. While White Zetsu is alive, whenever a ninja in your lineup is attacked for the first time in a round, all units in your lineup will have their Mystery's Chakra Cost decreased by 10 and if that damage is a Mystery's damage, decreases 20 instead (stackable up to 40), lasts until the end of the round.

Additional Skill; Wind: Causes unavoidable damage and Discouragement to all units in a random opponent's lineup and increases your lineup's Initiative by 3% (not stackable) until the end of the next round.

Additional Skill; Lightning: Causes unavoidable damage and Level 2 - Paralysis until the end of the round to all units in a random opponent's lineup and reduces Kakuzu's Mystery Cooldown by 1.

Additional Skill; Fire: Causes unavoidable damage and Suppress Immunity for 1 round to all units in a random opponent's lineup and dispels all Ignition Kakuzu currently has.

At the beginning of the battle, summons a Water Clone with 90% HP that has Taijutsu Attack and Earth Grudge Fear - Reattachment. While the Clone is alive, Kakuzu cannot be defeated by Mystery skills and after Kakuzu executes Taijutsu Attack, he randomly executes either: Earth Grudge Fear - Pressure Damage, Earth Grudge Fear - False Darkness or Earth Grudge Fear - Searing Migraine.

While Kakuzu is alive, at the end of the round, Water Clone revives a random defeated ally ninja to 30% HP. This skill is still active even when Water Clone is controlled. Cannot revive Kakuzu or bypass his Reincarnation delay.

If Kakuzu is defeated, revives 4 rounds after his defeat with 25% HP, reapplies all skills when he first entered the field and reduces his Mystery Cooldown to 0.

Kakuzu is immune to Debuffs and has high chances to evade Chase skills. If his Mystery defeats a unit, he recovers 20% HP and scales his Attack by 40%.

At the beginning of the battle, summons a Water Clone with 90% HP that has Taijutsu Attack and Earth Grudge Fear - Reattachment. While the Clone is alive, Kakuzu cannot be defeated by Mystery skills and after Kakuzu executes Taijutsu Attack, he randomly executes either: Earth Grudge Fear - Pressure Damage, Earth Grudge Fear - False Darkness or Earth Grudge Fear - Searing Migraine.

talentName: Chakra Burst / Susanoo Absolute Protection / Shadow Clone
talentDesc:
Chakra Burst: After Madara executes Fire Style - Majestic Fire Destruction, executes Additional Skill: Complete Body - Susano'o. talentName: Flying Raijin Jutsu / Prowess / Konoha Yellow Flash
talentDesc:
Shadow Clone Jutsu: Minato has Flying Raijin Jutsu. At the beginning of the battle, summons a Yellow Flash Clone with 100% HP. There can only be a maximum of 1 Yellow Flash Clone present in your lineup.

New Year Spirit - Space-Time Counter: Minato has high chances to evade Chase skills and after he executes his Mystery, he additionally gains high chances to evade Trigger skills until the end of the round. After he evades an attack, causes unavoidable damage, Suppress Super Armor for 1 round, High Float to a random opponent ninja and increases Minato's Trigger damage by 10% (stackable up to 100%).

Flying Raijin Jutsu: While Minato is alive, your lineup is immune to Debuffs and whenever they execute their Mystery skill, they also cause Flying Thunder Mark to the selected unit. Whenever your lineup executes a Trigger, scales Minato's Attack and Ninjutsu by 20%, can be triggered 6 times each round.

Konoha's Yellow Flash: Minato has Prowess, is immune to Flying Thunder Mark and whenever he evades an attack, scales his Critical Rate by 15%. After Minato suffers the first Mystery damage in a round, executes Shadow Clone Jutsu. After the Yellow Flash Clone executes Space-Time - Counter, reduces Minato's Mystery Cooldown to 0 and he can execute his Mystery skill again, can be triggered twice each round.

Yellow Flash: Yellow Flash Clone is immune to Debuffs and Flying Thunder Mark. Whenever it evades an attack, scales its Critical Rate by 15%.

Space-Time - Counter: Yellow Flash Clone has high chances to evade Chase and Trigger skills and after it evades an attack, causes unavoidable damage, Suppress Super Armor for 1 round, High Float to a random opponent ninja and increases its Trigger damage by 10% (stackable up to 100%).

Konoha's Yellow Flash: Passive: Whenever Minato's HP reaches 50% for the first time in a battle, dispels all Debuffs he currently has, recovers 70% HP, resets his action count and his Mystery changes to Enhanced New Year Combo - Rasen-Flash Super-Circle Dance Howl (Mystery, Battlefield Cooldown: 0, Cooldown: 2, Chakra Cost: 0). Causes unavoidable damage and Interruption to all units in the opponent's field. If the selected unit is suffering from Flying Thunder Mark, increases this skill's damage by 40%, additionally reduces the selected unit's Mystery damage by 75% (not stackable) until that unit executes a Mystery skill and during that round, whenever that selected unit is attacked by a Mystery skill, reduces that unit's Trigger damage by 15% (stackable up to 75%) until the end of the battle.

Space-Time - Counter: Yellow Flash Clone has high chances to evade Chase and Trigger skills and after it evades an attack, causes unavoidable damage, Suppress Super Armor for 1 round, High Float to a random opponent ninja and increases its Trigger damage by 10% (stackable up to 100%).

Yellow Flash: Yellow Flash Clone is immune to Debuffs and Flying Thunder Mark. Whenever it evades an attack, scales its Critical Rate by 15%.

Divine - Deep Forest Emergence: After executing Infinite Tsukuyomi, activates the Divine - Deep Forest Emergence Barrier for 2 rounds. On the round of its activation, opponents cannot gain additional Chakra from skills or effects and their healing received is reduced by 80%.

Ten-Tails Jinchuriki: Madara has Advanced Immunity, Divine - Absorption and if he is defeated, revives 3 rounds later with 80% HP. While Madara is alive, whenever any ninja in both fields executes an action, scale Madara's Physical ATK by 10%, can be triggered 8 times per round.

Divine - Absorption: Madara has a high chance to evade an attack every round and after he evades one, recovers 100 Chakra, then executes Extreme - Limbo - Shadow Thunder Prison.

Divine - Deep Forest Emergence Barrier: Under this Barrier, ally units cannot suffer from Slumber and Paralysis, and opponent units cannot receive Explosive Mode.

Limbo - Border Jail: Attacks all units in a random opponent lineup and steals all their Standard Attack attempts, causes Repulse to a unit hit. This skill never misses and after executed, Madara's Standard Attack changes to Shadow Style - Thunder Dance.

Limbo - Shadow Thunder Prison: Triggered with at least 30 Combo, causes damage, Level 2 - Paralysis to all units in the opponent's field and removes their Perseverance. This skill never misses and ignores a certain amount of Resistance.

Limbo - Complete Body - Susano'o: Causes damage, Suppress Super Armor until the end of the next round to all units in the opponent's field and removes their Explosive Mode, causes Defense Shatter and Knockdown to the selected unit. After this skill is executed, Madara's Mystery changes to Infinite Tsukuyomi.

Extreme - Limbo - Shadow Thunder Prison: Additional Skill: Causes damage and Level 2 - Paralysis to all units in the opponent's field and removes their Perseverance. This skill never misses, ignores a certain amount of Resistance and after executed, Madara can execute his Mystery skill once more in that round.

talentName: Power of Six Paths / Power of Friendship
talentDesc:
Six Paths - Multiple Tailed Beast Rasen-Shuriken: After your lineup executes the first Mystery and Trigger in a round, Naruto executes Additional Skill: Tailed Beast Repeated Rasen-Shuriken to cause unavoidable damage, Interruption and Suppress Super Armor for 1 round to all units in the opponent's field.

Power of Friendship: Naruto has Power of Six Paths. Every time your lineup is attacked, dispels all Fear they currently have, increases their Standard Attack damage by 15% (stackable up to 6 times) and Jinchuriki ninjas in your lineup will have their Standard Attack becomes unavoidable, last until the end of the round.

Power of Six Paths: Passive: Naruto has Advanced Immunity and whenever he executes a Mystery skill, scale his Physical ATK by 12%. If Naruto activates Kokuo Resonance, executes Six Paths - Recovery (Trigger: Naruto resets his action count.) immediately and Six Paths - Restoration (Trigger: Naruto dispels all Debuffs (including Level 2 Debuffs), resets his action count and sets Tailed Beast Bond back to its initial state.) at the end of the round. Six Paths - Recovery and Six Paths - Restoration each recover 10% of Naruto's max HP.

Shukaku: Effect: Whenever Naruto activates Shukaku Resonance, dispels all Blindness he currently has. While having this Resonance, Naruto's Standard Attack causes Slow Reflex. Lasts until the end of the round.

Matatabi: Effect: Whenever Naruto activates Matatabi Resonance, dispels all Blindness he currently has. While having this Resonance, Naruto's Standard Attack causes Level 2 - Ignition. Lasts until the end of the round.

Isobu: Effect: Whenever Naruto activates Isobu Resonance, dispels all Blindness he currently has. While having this Resonance, Naruto's Standard Attack causes Discouragement. Lasts until the end of the round.

Son Goku: Effect: Whenever Naruto activates Son Goku Resonance, dispels all Blindness he currently has. While having this Resonance, Naruto's Standard Attack causes Inferno. Lasts until the end of the round.

Kokuo: Effect: After Naruto activates Kokuo Resonance, dispels all Debuffs (including Level 2 Debuffs) he currently has. While having this Resonance, Naruto's Standard Attack causes Defense Shatter. Lasts until the end of the round.

Saiken: Effect: Whenever Naruto activates Saiken Resonance, dispels all Blindness he currently has. While having this Resonance, Naruto's Standard Attack causes Melt. Lasts until the end of the round.

Chomei: Effect: Whenever Naruto activates Chomei Resonance, dispels all Blindness he currently has. While having this Resonance, Naruto's Standard Attack causes Level 2 - Blindness. Lasts until the end of the round.

Gyuki: Effect: Whenever Naruto activates Gyuki Resonance, dispels all Blindness he currently has. While having this Resonance, whenever Naruto's Standard Attack causes Knockdown, he also causes Dye Ink to that unit. Lasts until the end of the round.

Kurama: Effect: Whenever Naruto activates Kurama Resonance, dispels all Blindness he currently has. While having this Resonance, whenever Naruto's Standard Attack defeats a unit, he receives an Extra Standard Attack. Lasts until the end of the round.

Six Paths - Super Massive Rasen-Shuriken: Mystery; Battlefield Cooldown: 0, Cooldown: 2, Chakra: 40: Causes unavoidable damage neglecting Shields to all units in the opponent's field, causes Knockdown and Level 2 - Weakness for 1 round to the selected unit. If there's only 1 unit in the opponent's field, increase this skill's damage by 100%. If the selected unit is a Female unit, executes Sexy Jutsu - Reverse Harem Jutsu instead, which causes Interruption, Level 2 - Slowness to the selected unit and reduces that unit's damage caused by 60% (not stackable), last until the end of the round. The skill is unavoidable.

Kurama - Tailed Beast Bomb: Standard Attack: Attacks all units in the opponent's lineup and causes Suppress Immunity until the end of the next round, causes Knockdown to a unit hit. This skill neglects Shields and has additonal Critical Rate increase.

Kurama Chakra Cloak: At the beginning of battle, Naruto grants Kurama Chakra to his entire lineup, increasing Physical ATK and Physical DEF by 50%, increasing Speed by 10% and granting 50% Life Steal for the battle. Life Steal restores HP based on actual damage dealt. This buff does not stack with another Naruto Final Battle.

talentName: Eight Inner Gates / Night Guy / Youth Last Shield
talentDesc:
Gate of Death - Night Guy: Whenever Guy's Mystery skill is interrupted, reduces his Mystery Cooldown to 0. Whenever Guy suffers fatal damage, executes Death Skill: Night Guy, then he becomes defeated and cannot be revived. Exception: with Naruto Uzumaki [The Final Battle] in his starting lineup, Guy can revive once with 50% max HP after Night Guy. Revival does not reset this allowance.

Overflowing Youth - Steam of Blood: Before an action, consumes 10% HP to grant himself Level 2 Super Armor and high chances to evade Standard Attacks, last until the end of the round, and increase Guy's Physical ATK by 60% (stackable up to 10 times) and Initiative by 5% (stackable up to 3 times).

Eight Inner Gates - Gate of Death: Guy is immune to Debuffs and cannot suffer from Suppress Immunity or receive Healings. Whenever he executes a Mystery, consumes 10% HP. For every 1% HP Guy currently loses, increase your lineup's Physical ATK by 2% and Critical Rate by 1%.

Youth's Last Shield: During rounds 1 and 2, Guy intercepts all incoming damage aimed at his allies and gains 200% Physical DEF. Damage is mitigated using Guy's Physical DEF. If multiple Guys are present, only one intercepts each hit. With Naruto Uzumaki [The Final Battle] in the starting lineup, Guy can revive once with 50% max HP, overriding his own Night Guy revival prohibition. Enemy effects that forbid revival still prevent this rescue.

Evening Elephant Statuses: Evening Elephant - Restraint: Level 2 Debuff; cannot execute Standard Attacks until round end. Evening Elephant - Immobility: Level 2 Debuff; cannot execute most actions until round end. Guy receives his own Elephant status even while immune to external Debuffs. Level 2 Super Armor prevents Low Float, High Float, Repulse and Knockdown and lower-level Suppress Super Armor. If Night Guy is disabled, fatal damage leaves Guy at 1 HP until he is defeated at round end. The Naruto rescue is an external revival and is still limited to one use. HP costs stop at 1 HP and do not count as attack damage.
